dialogues.speaker: Momoko
dialogues.text: My husband is a soldier in the Sangonomiya forces. He's currently stationed near Yashiori Island.

dialogues.speaker: Momoko
dialogues.text: I'm not all too familiar with the situation out there. My husband's letters don't mention the war at all. His letters are full of assurances that he's well and that there's no need to worry...

dialogues.speaker: Momoko
dialogues.text: But to tell the truth, how can I not worry about him, as his wife?

dialogues.speaker: Momoko
dialogues.text: *sigh* I miss the days when we had no such cares. When times got busy, we would be busy together. When we were free, we would watch the flowers together...

dialogues.speaker: Momoko
dialogues.text: May Watatsumi Omikami watch over my husband and ensure his safe return.
